label: Auto Loop Karoo (Karoo 2)
description: Automatically scrolls through your ride data pages so you can focus on riding. Navigation-aware: switches to the map page before a turn and resumes scrolling after it. Per-page dwell time, skip pages, optional sound feedback.
releaseNotes: 1.2.4: alerts for what happens by itself (scroll ON at ride start or resume and after a turn, scroll OFF on pause and ride end) now have their own switch, Automatic alerts, on by default; the alerts for what you change (from the app, the Switches field, the lap button) always show. Updated Kotlin and coroutines. Settings are kept on update.
